{{/* REQ: LANG-951 LANG-952 LANG-953 LANG-954 */}}
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-config
  labels:
    app: {{ .Values.app | quote }}
data:
{{- range $key, $value := .Values.settings }}
  {{ $key }}: {{ $value | printf "%q" }}
{{- end }}
{{- if and .Values.enabled (gt (len .Values.items) 0) }}
  enabled: "true"
{{- else }}
  enabled: "false"
{{- end }}
{{ define "greeting" }}<p>Hello, {{ .Name | html }}!</p>{{ end }}
{{ template "greeting" . }} {{ with $x := `raw` }}{{ $x }}{{ end }}
